name: uss-blackwell-red-matter-core-calculator-mcp
description: MCP server for USS Blackwell red matter core dimensional fold calculations in the Star Trek fanfiction universe - includes long-range interstellar jumps and short-range tactical jumps
author: Kyt Dotson

tools.name: blackwell_describe
tools.description: Returns metadata about the USS Blackwell Red Matter Core MCP Server including vessel designation, narrative description, and available tools

tools.name: long_range_describe
tools.description: Provides comprehensive reference documentation about the Magellan unit, dimensional fold equation, efficiency zones, safety boundaries, and example calculations

tools.name: long_range_jump_distance
tools.description: Calculates jump distance in light-years for a given red matter field strength in Magellans (forward calculation)

tools.name: long_range_field_strength
tools.description: Calculates required red matter field strength in Magellans for a target jump distance in light-years (inverse calculation)

tools.name: short_range_describe
tools.description: Provides comprehensive reference documentation about the tactical jump system including physics, adjustable parameters, equations, operational limits, criticality thresholds, and Rizan's Resonance Bridge Theory

tools.name: short_range_jump_distance
tools.description: Calculates achievable tactical jump distance in meters for given charge time and system parameters (forward calculation with criticality assessment)

tools.name: short_range_field_strength
tools.description: Calculates required Magellan field strength for target tactical jump distance using Newton-Raphson iteration (inverse calculation with feasibility assessment)

tools.name: short_range_criticality
tools.description: Assesses system criticality risk for current or planned operational state, providing detailed breakdown of red matter and warp core components with tactical recommendations

tools.name: short_range_sequential_jumps
tools.description: Plans and analyzes sequences of multiple tactical jumps, tracking cumulative criticality buildup and identifying when operations become unsafe

tools.name: short_range_optimize_cochrane
tools.description: Finds optimal Cochrane field settings for current phase offset and subspace resonance conditions, identifying safe operating zones
